data.description:
The player should shoot in the player gym scene. There should be a number of obstacles in the scene that cannot be destroyed but will destroy the player if they crash into them. The goal is to create an environment that the player has to navigate around learning to use their thrusters.

We need a visual indicator that shields are ending. Make the inside of the shield circle opaque and pulse the rim for 1 second before fully dissappearing. In the last half second the internal shading should shrink until they are smaller than the ship and thus ineffective. Then they dissappear.:
